integrity: Exact rational Bellman verification accompanies the proof; first-public source date is that of arXiv v1, not the journal publication.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample concerns K_(1,2,6) and a root in its two-vertex part; no general tripartite classification or minimum-order assertion.
The modified policy need not be globally optimal.
Independent mathematical and historical-priority validation have not been performed.
title: Bipartite greediness and a tripartite cover-time counterexample
